assumptions: The odds do not say what process they describe. Modelled as: n carriers and one hazard, each with an i.i.d. lifetime; the line survives when the longest-lived is a carrier.
The claim is checked at its largest case, n = 10 (q = 10/11 = 90.9%); the curve covers n = 1 to 10.
Lifetimes exponential; any continuous i.i.d. distribution gives the same ordering odds.
plan: Draw 2 million rounds of n + 1 lifetimes for each n from 1 to 10 and count the rounds where a carrier outlives the hazard. The share at n = 10 is compared with 90.9%.
